resolution: The quinta via's dichotomy 'by chance or by intention' (STMT-REGULAR-BEST-BY-CHANCE-OR-BY-INTENTION) uses the broad sense, tending to an end; read as conscious purpose it would assume the knower the argument concludes to. The knower enters only through the separate premise STMT-NON-COGNITIVE-TENDING-NEEDS-KNOWING-DIRECTOR, so the argument does not equivocate between the two senses.
